description: This source file implements a plugin radio factory loader that dynamically loads shared libraries, creates radio factory instances, and wraps radio sessions with dynamic library handles. It defines classes for managing dynamic libraries and radio sessions, and provides a function to load a plugin radio factory by name.

classes.name: radio_dynamic_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps a radio_session with a dynamic library handle, forwarding calls to the underlying session.

classes.name: radio_factory_dynamic_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps a radio_factory with a dynamic library handle, creating radio sessions and managing resource cleanup.

methods.name: create_plugin_radio_factory
methods.description: Loads a shared library plugin by name, retrieves a factory creation function, and returns a wrapped radio_factory instance.
